headline: HuyenBao v11.29 — Khỏe yếu thì ĐƯỢC khám & chữa trị ngay (hết khoá 30 ngày cứng) + Admin dashboard quản trị toàn diện + npm start port 3334 cho mogul.huyenbao.com
summary: HEALTH TRIAGE + FULL ADMIN CONSOLE. The doctor check-up no longer hard-locks you for 30 days: its cooldown now adapts to your health — 30 days when you're fine, 7 days under 60, and just 1 day under 35 (⚡ shown when the urgent rate applies). A new deep MEDICAL TREATMENT action (Chữa trị) heals +45 for $3,000 on a 5-day cooldown for when you're truly weak. The /admin dashboard grew from read-only stats into a full console with 5 tabs: Overview (players / online / banned / messages / gifts / DB size), Players (search, inline edit of name/avatar/level/net-worth, ban & unban, permanent delete), Chat (delete a message, wipe all of a user, broadcast 📢 system announcements), Gifts (log + delete) and DB (VACUUM, wipe chat). All /api/admin/* routes share a timing-safe ADMIN_KEY guard; banned accounts are blocked from chat & gifts server-side with a schema migration (players.banned). `npm start` now serves 0.0.0.0:3334 to match the mogul.huyenbao.com reverse proxy, and deploy/ ships Caddy + nginx configs, a systemd unit and a step-by-step VPS guide.
features: CHECKUP TRIAGE: cooldown 30d → 7d when health < 60 → 1d when health < 35 (no more dying while waiting out a routine visit)
NEW ACTION — TREATMENT (Chữa trị): +45 health, $3,000, 5-day cooldown, own icon, EN/VI/ZH localised
ADMIN CONSOLE: 5 tabs (Tổng quan / Người chơi / Trò chuyện / Quà tặng / CSDL) at /admin
PLAYERS ADMIN: search by name or HB-code, inline edit name/avatar/level/net worth, ban/unban, permanent delete (cascades chat/edges/gifts)
CHAT MODERATION: delete single messages, wipe everything by a user, broadcast 📢 HuyenBao system announcements into global chat
BAN ENFORCEMENT: banned players rejected server-side on chat & gifts (403), silent graceful handling in the client
GIFTS LOG: last 100 transfers with sender/receiver/amount/note/claim state, deletable
DB MAINTENANCE: VACUUM compaction + destructive chat wipe (double-confirmed)
SECURITY: shared timing-safe ADMIN_KEY guard for every /api/admin/* route, fail-closed when the env var is missing
DEPLOY: npm start = next start -H 0.0.0.0 -p 3334; deploy/ has Caddyfile.mogul, nginx-mogul.conf, huyenbao.service (systemd) and a VPS guide
TESTS: engine tests for adaptive checkup + treatment; socialDb tests for ban/unban, moderation, broadcast, admin stats
Version bumped to v11.29 at FRONT of app name
